{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its aggressive melodic metal fits my interest in Advance And Vanquish and the In Flames albums; I'd choose it now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The heavy riffs and unusual rhythms appeal after Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days; I'd try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Curse; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic heaviness sounds appealing, but other metal albums here are stronger choices this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Trapt       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits the accessible rock side of my history, though I'm leaning toward heavier music today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ascendancy       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its blend of melody and aggressive metal closely matches what draws me to In Flames; I'd choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The mix of intensity and melodic hooks fits my current interest in heavy but memorable songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Crusade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash direction interests me, but I'd explore Ascendancy first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Natural Selection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic hard rock fits The Reason and One Day Remains, but isn't my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lonely Position of Neutral; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its more restrained melodic rock is less appealing while I'm looking for heavier riffs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lost and Found       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves fit my interest in Ten Thousand Fists, but I'd save it for another visit."}
